## TRA Timeline

#### Form-of attached to Merger Agreement

- 2024-08-26: Merger Agreement with Events.com signed; form-of Tax Receivable Agreement filed as Exhibit 10.4 to the August 27, 2024 8-K; preamble date and Schedule A blank
- 2024-08-26?: Origination date inferred from Merger Agreement signing; executed date will be the Closing Date

#### Combination period extensions, no Closing

- 2024 through 2025: Combination Period extended; merger not closed
- 2025-12: Combination Period further extended to December 31, 2026 via stockholder vote
- 2026-03-31: Latest 10-Q in directory; merger still not closed

## Explanation

This is a form-of (unexecuted) TRA attached to the August 2024 Merger Agreement between SPAC Concord Acquisition Corp II and Events.com, Inc.; the contract would obligate the post-merger entity (Parent, to be renamed Events.com, Inc.) to pay Events.com Sellers 85% of Realized Tax Benefit on pre-Closing tax attributes of the Group Companies, including net operating loss carryforwards. The preamble date and Schedule A of Sellers are both blank in the form-of. As of the most recent filing (Q1 FY2026 10-Q), the Concord/Events.com merger has not closed: the Combination Period was extended twice and now runs through December 31, 2026. Status is `Unknown` rather than `Ongoing` because the TRA has never been executed; it will only enter force if the merger closes, and it would otherwise lapse if the merger agreement is terminated. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
